svg.title: What the Kit handles and what stays with you
svg.desc: Code changes → your chosen assistant Rules, checks and project memory → the Kit Branch, PR, CI waiting, merge → Kit commands Requirements and priorities Design and architecture decisions Review and approval before merge Git setup and repair The generated-project walkthrough simulates GitHub and a passing CI result.
